summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of ESIP (Enterprise Sales Intelligence Platform) MVP. All backend APIs (100% success rate) and frontend UI components are fully functional. Minor backend bugs were identified and fixed during testing.

fixed_bugs.issue: Connection ID mismatch - MongoDB ObjectID returned instead of UUID
fixed_bugs.fix: Set both _id and id fields to UUID to prevent MongoDB from generating ObjectID

fixed_bugs.issue: Pipeline Health endpoint returning 500 error due to timezone-aware/naive datetime mismatch
fixed_bugs.fix: Added timezone handling to ensure all datetime comparisons use timezone-aware datetimes

fixed_bugs.issue: Pipeline Health endpoint failing when updated_at field doesn't exist
fixed_bugs.fix: Added $exists check in MongoDB query and fallback to created_at
